summary: Adds a discount_code field and an apply_discount method on Order. Adds order detail and discount redeem endpoints.

findings.title: Order detail does not check the owner
findings.problem: order_detail looks up the order by primary key alone and never filters by request.user. The sibling views order_list and redeem both filter by owner.
findings.consequence: Any logged-in user can read the total and discount code of every other user's order. An attacker can enumerate all orders by incrementing the id.
findings.fix: Add owner=request.user to the get_object_or_404 lookup, as redeem already does.

findings.title: Decimal multiplied by float
findings.problem: apply_discount multiplies total, a Decimal, by the float 0.9. Python raises TypeError when it multiplies a Decimal by a float.
findings.consequence: Every redeem request with the WELCOME10 code fails with a server error. No user can ever get the discount.
findings.fix: Multiply by Decimal("0.9") and round to two decimal places with quantize.

findings.title: New field has no migration
findings.problem: The change adds the discount_code field to Order but adds no migration. The orders app has only 0001_initial, and it lacks this column.
findings.consequence: Every Order query selects a missing column and fails at runtime. This breaks order_list as well as the new endpoints.
findings.fix: Run makemigrations for the orders app and commit the generated migration that adds discount_code.

findings.title: CSRF protection disabled on a session-authenticated POST
findings.problem: The redeem view disables CSRF checks but authenticates users with the session cookie. The settings enable CsrfViewMiddleware for every other view.
findings.consequence: A third-party site can make a logged-in user's browser redeem the code. The one-time code then lands on an order the user did not choose.
findings.fix: Remove the csrf_exempt decorator and have clients send the CSRF token with the POST.

findings.title: New discount and view behaviour has no test
findings.problem: No test covers apply_discount, order_detail or redeem. The repository contains no test files.
findings.consequence: A test would have caught the crash in apply_discount and the missing owner check in order_detail.
findings.fix: Add tests for the discount, for repeat redemption and for access to another user's order.
